exposure: gestational weight gain (GWG) patterns (below-target, within-target, above-target)
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing external cephalic version (ECV) with neuraxial analgesia and tocolysis at Fudan University Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital between 2018 and 2024 were included.
finding: Pregnant women with below-target gestational weight gain showed significantly higher external cephalic version (ECV) success rates under combined neuraxial analgesia and tocolysis compared to those with within-target or above-target GWG.
mod_finding: Below-target gestational weight gain was associated with higher external cephalic version success rates, a procedure aimed at reducing cesarean section rates.
